text:
harper: I opened PR 1722 to unify the Console observability examples: migrating dashboard JSON, updating trace snippet examples (python/go), and adding a tiny cost attribution example. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1722
liam: Quick glance: python snippet still uses the old `trace_hook` name. We should use `client.trace_context.configure(...)` and show add_tag for cost. Also one dashboard widget uses `inference_ms` — swap to `latency_p50_ms`/`latency_p95_ms`.
nina: There's a broken cross-link from /console/observability to /console/metrics#cost. I'll grep and fix. Also suggest adding a one-line note about Dedicated deployments needing collector endpoints open for OTLP.
harper: Good. For the cost example let's include formula text: `cost_usd = tokens * 0.00055` and show grouping by model + route. Keep it tiny.
liam: Pushed a small fix: replaced trace_hook with trace_context in Python, added sampling example, and updated the code fence. Example now:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.trace_context.configure(sampling=0.1, exporters=["otlp"])
client.trace_context.add_tag("cost_usd", lambda tokens: tokens * 0.00055)
```
nina: Patched the dashboard JSON to use `latency_p95_ms` and adjusted the widget time window to 1h for p95. Also updated the anchor to /console/metrics#cost-and-latency. Pushed.
docs-bot: linkcheck: 1 broken anchor found earlier, now fixed. CI queued.
harper: Can someone take the backport to release/1.2-docs? Dedicated customers rely on those dashboard templates.
liam: I'll open the backport PR after merge.
docs-bot: build-docs: All checks passed for branch docs/1722.
harper: Great, merging in 2 minutes unless any objections. After merge I'll add a short eval checklist to the PR (smoke snippets, import dashboard to staging, verify cost formulas). Thanks :raised_hands:
